name: browser-use
headline: claude specKit updates: github management
short_description: Automates SpecKit updates on Windows 11, preserving customizations. Operations teams benefit by reducing manual update efforts. Connects to GitHub repositories and integrates with PowerShell workflows.
author: NotMyself

sections.overview:
This Claude Code skill provides automated, safe updates for SpecKit installations on Windows 11 without losing your customizations. It uses fingerprint-based version detection and intelligent 3-way merging to reduce merge conflicts from ~15 to 0-2, with zero conflicts for first-time users. The skill automatically creates timestamped backups before updates, detects which files you've customized, and rolls back automatically if anything fails. Operations teams benefit by eliminating destructive `specify init --force` commands and manual update coordination. For teams requiring higher GitHub API rate limits, optional authentication via GitHub PAT is supported.
Safely update SpecKit templates across team projects without losing custom configurations
Automate routine SpecKit version upgrades in PowerShell-based CI/CD workflows
Preserve customized commands and scripts during SpecKit updates
Perform dry-run checks before applying SpecKit updates to production projects
The SpecKit update process has been successfully automated for [COMPANY]. All customizations have been preserved, and the system is now running the latest version.
